subject: Midnight deploy 500/429 spike - verification request & SLA remediation path
messages:
From: Sarah Kim <sarah@cartwave.com>
To: aisha.rahman@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-08-27T00:18:00-07:00
Subject: Checkout failures: 500/429 errors during midnight deploy (Aug 27)

Hi Aisha,

We started seeing a sustained spike of 500 and 429 responses across checkout endpoints around 23:45 PDT during your midnight deploy window. Over the next ~25 minutes our customers experienced failed payment handoffs and a ~14% drop in completed checkouts.

Attached are a few request_id examples and a short snippet of the errors (client side). Can you confirm Redwood's availability and routing for the region and advise whether this meets the SLA failure criteria? CartWave needs an initial credit estimate and an ETA for the postmortem.

Immediate ask: please confirm the precise downtime window you observe and next steps for evidence collection.

Thanks,
Sarah Kim
Head of Payments, CartWave

Attachment: client_error_snippets.txt
From: aisha.rahman@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Kim <sarah@cartwave.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-08-27T01:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Checkout failures: 500/429 errors during midnight deploy (Aug 27)

Hi Sarah — thanks for the heads up and the examples. I'm escalating this to our SRE and Customer Success teams for immediate triage.

What we'll do now:
- SRE (cc'd: soojin) will pull the request-level routing traces and backend 5xx/429 counts for your account across the 23:30–00:30 PDT window.
- We'll consolidate whether there were model-serving timeouts, router throttles, or region-level failovers.
- CS (cc'd: Marissa) will track your business impact and coordinate any required credits.

Can you confirm whether the failures correlate with a single checkout path (checkout.v2) or multiple endpoints? Also please add any additional request_ids to the thread.

For transparency: if we verify an availability gap that meets the SLA definition (sustained error rate and availability threshold breach), we'll compute pro-rata credits per the contract and include them in the remediation plan. We'll share a preliminary incident timeline within 24 hours and a full postmortem within 5 business days.

— Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: aisha.rahman@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-08-27T02:15:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Requesting verification of 23:45–00:10 PDT error window for CartWave (account CW-2027)

Team — Sarah reported a concentrated 500/429 spike aligned with our midnight deploy. Please run the following checks and attach results to the incident folder:

1) Service-side error counts: aggregate 5xx and 429 by minute for the region and the model stack for account CartWave between 23:30–00:30 PDT.
2) Router/edge throttling events: show any circuit-breaker trips or rate-limiter logs affecting that account or region.
3) Deployer timeline: pin the deploy tasks that started near 23:40 PDT; confirm whether a canary rollback or shard eviction occurred.
4) KV/cache warmup metrics: provide any cold-start indicators that would increase latency and error rates.

Please include the raw trace bundle (raw_trace_bundle.tar.gz) and a short README (query_instructions.md) for our support analysts. If this meets the SLA availability definition (service availability < 99.9% for the window), we'll prepare a credit calculation and draft a postmortem timeline for the customer.

Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager

Attachment: query_instructions.md
From: aisha.rahman@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Kim <sarah@cartwave.com>, ops@cartwave.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-08-27T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Checkout failures: 500/429 errors during midnight deploy (Aug 27) — preliminary findings and next steps

Hi Sarah — quick update after our initial triage:

Preliminary timeline (subject to finalized evidence):
- 23:38 PDT: midnight deploy triggered for model-serving cluster in us-west-2.
- 23:42–00:06 PDT: sustained elevated 5xx/429 rates affecting requests routed to a subset of shards serving CartWave (approx. 17 minutes).
- 23:58 PDT: automated rollback on the canary group; normal traffic resumed by 00:06.

What we are doing now:
- SRE is assembling a raw trace bundle (attached) and a minute-by-minute error/availability CSV for your review.
- CS will compute an estimated pro-rata credit if the verified availability for the contract period falls below the SLA threshold.
- We'll publish a postmortem draft within 72 hours and finalize within 5 business days.

Next steps for you: please confirm whether the business impact window above aligns with CartWave's observed revenue drop; if you have more request_ids, send them and we'll prioritize log extraction.

Attachments: raw_trace_bundle.tar.gz (contains Router traces and per-request latencies), client_error_snippets.txt

We take this seriously and will provide the evidence package and credit estimate shortly.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
